_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). Only the two NOT-caught axes are declared kept-red: the baseline/invisible/hidden tests PASS on correct code and are deliberately not declared.

expectedRed.testName: opacity-0 (Tailwind → opacity:0) is NOT caught — the bug the old enumeration missed
expectedRed.why: On correct code the measurement-based guard raises for an opacity-0 element, so `expect(...).not.toThrow()` fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the guard regressed to the old classList enumeration that misses opacity.

expectedRed.testName: aria-hidden="true" on the icon is NOT caught — the bug the old enumeration missed
expectedRed.why: On correct code the guard reads aria-hidden directly and raises, so `expect(...).not.toThrow()` fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the guard regressed to the old classList enumeration that misses aria-hidden.
